newsitem.title: CHINA: China July consumer retail sales up 13 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: China July consumer retail sales up 13 pct yr/yr.

text.p: China's retail sales of consumer goods in July rose 13 percent year-on-year, or 12.3 percent after inflation, to 210.3 billion yuan ($25.3 billion), spurred by brisk sales in consumer durables, state figures showed on Tuesday.

Unusually hot weather in northern China stimulated purchases of air conditioners, electric fans, and beverages, while sales of consumer durables such as video compact disc players and large-screen televisions were also booming, the State Statistical Bureau said.
Urban retail sales of consumer goods reached 129.5 billion yuan in July, rising 13.6 percent year-on-year, while rural sales grew by 12 percent, reaching 80.8 billion yuan, it said.
Sales reached 1.510 trillion yuan in the first seven months of the year, rising 13.8 percent from the same period last year, or 12 percent after adjustment for inflation, it said.
